name: The Fate of Zephras

angles.text: As a Skyborne of Zephras Isle, you face the loss of the wards and the threat of Al'Akir. Your people now look beyond their floating home for a way to protect it.
As a shaman, you know the Windlord Al'Akir's elemental domain surrounds Zephras. With the ancient wards gone, the island lies exposed.

aliases: what is the fate of zephras
what happens in the fate of zephras
faq.answer: Lorthuna has fallen at the Shrine of Akir, and word of the danger goes to Valanaar. The island's protective wards have failed, and Ayessa proposes an expedition to Azeroth. High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong receives the news.
faq.q: What is the quest The Fate of Zephras about?

faq.answer: Zephras Isle lies within the elemental domain of Al'Akir, the Windlord. Ancient wards once hid the sanctuary from his sight. Now they are gone, leaving the island exposed should Al'Akir turn his wrath upon it.
faq.q: Why is Zephras Isle in danger from Al'Akir?

faq.answer: Talaanis Shadowsong is the High Elder of the Skyborne in Valanaar on Zephras Isle. He oversees his people's rule and survival, and receives reports of threats and choices facing their home.
Ayessa plans to lead an expedition from Zephras Isle to Azeroth. She seeks answers and allies beyond their domain to help protect her people from Al'Akir.
Lorthuna led the cult on Zephras Isle. She was slain above the Shrine of Akir, breaking the cult's leadership as the island's protective wards fell.
faq.q: Who was Lorthuna and what happened to her?

faq.answer: Muln is an advisor or scholar who knows about the elemental lords. He warned Zephras's defenders of Al'Akir's great power and danger, and confirmed their vulnerability without magical concealment.

sections.body: Lorthuna has fallen after the battle above the Shrine of Akir. Yet Zephras Isle has paid dearly for the victory. Its ancient wards, which hid it from Al'Akir, have collapsed. The floating sanctuary now lies exposed in the Windlord's domain. A messenger crosses the isle with word for Valanaar.
sections.title: A Precarious Victory

sections.body: High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong hears that Lorthuna is dead and the wards have broken. He also learns that Ayessa means to lead an expedition to Azeroth. With their magical veil gone, the islanders look beyond their home for a way to protect it. Shadowsong weighs fear against hope. Al'Akir is a terrible menace, yet elemental gods move across vast stretches of time. That may leave the islanders precious time to act.
sections.title: The Word to Valanaar

summary: After Lorthuna falls, word of danger reaches Valanaar. Zephras Isle's wards have failed, and Ayessa proposes a journey to Azeroth. High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong must hear what has happened.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Fate of Zephras
